title: Binary Tree Right Side View
prompt: Given the root of a binary tree, imagine yourself standing on the right side of it. Return the values of the nodes you can see ordered from top to bottom.
hints: BFS level order: the last node of each level is the rightmost. Or traverse right-to-left and take first of each level.
DFS: visit right child before left. For each level, the first node we see (rightmost) gets added. Track result.length to know if we've seen this level.
Recursive: pass level. If result.length === level, we haven't seen this level - push the value. Visit right before left.
